representation: cases are fully materialized captures with protocol_hex,authority_hex,run_files[{locator,raw_hex}], plus a synthetic finite bindings object. Hex is exact raw bytes, including LF. Declared external metadata pins are synthetic unexpanded leaves; no named path is opened. No actual old run is replayed.

expected_result_projection.meaning: Well-typed bounded fixture captures with invalid inner source data expect inconsistent graph summaries, not a successful result or normalization. Missing allowed evidence expects incomplete. Any known failure filename is a negative veto before its malformed contents can be parsed away. Caller check exceptions remain exceptional, never successful summaries. This projection does not expand the v3 checker scope.

normal_branch: The complete source-shaped fixture uses root parent-reservation.json and execution/journal.jsonl. First build_reserved owner PID equals reservation; second attempt header binds exact captured protocol hash and limits. Receipt/cleanup/terminal references follow actual source order; result rows are opaque synthetic bytes and cannot establish native/semantic success.
negative_branches: root publication failure after positive receipt
normal late cleanup marker before terminal
exception late supplement after older positive terminal
after-seal failure pinning older positive terminal
prior close failure followed by successful sealer retry
early journal initialization failure with negative receipt/seal and missing normal files
boundary: This file defines fixture interchange/expected projections only. It is not an implemented archive checker, profile binding, runtime protocol, source-authority proof or execution permission.
